channel.title: Pimsleur Language Programs - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pimsleur Language Programs (pimsleur.com)

item.title: Repeat After Me: A Life Shaped by Language
item.description: Repeat After Me is a personal account of what it feels like to live a life shaped by language — learning it, struggling with it, relying on it, and returning to it again and again.

item.title: The Science of Language Acquisition: How the Brain Learns a New Language
item.description: Learn how the brain handles language acquisition, the stages involved, and why certain methods help adults build fluency faster based on cognitive science.

item.title: How the Pimsleur Method Leverages the Brain’s Natural Ability to Learn
item.description: Explore how natural language learning works and why the Pimsleur Method aligns with the brain’s innate ability to acquire languages naturally.

item.title: The Importance of Pronunciation: Why Pimsleur Focuses on Speaking from Day One
item.description: Learn why Pimsleur emphasizes pronunciation from day one, helping language learners speak confidently and correctly right from the start.

item.title: Mastering Medical Spanish Quickly: Efficient Learning Tips for Healthcare Workers
item.description: Discover efficient techniques to master medical Spanish quickly, helping busy healthcare workers communicate better with patients in need.

item.title: Why You Understand a Language but Can’t Speak It
item.description: If you understand a language but can't speak it, discover the reasons for this common language barrier, how to break it and practical ways to overcome it.

item.title: From Stumped to Speaking: The Art of Language Learning Through Mistakes
item.description: Discover why language learning mistakes are actually your greatest asset, how to embrace them, and how learning a language through mistakes builds confidence.

item.title: Getting Comfortably Conversational: How to Build Confidence in Speaking Another Language
item.description: Struggling to speak another language confidently? Learn practical, step-by-step tips on how to build confidence in speaking and become more fluent.

item.title: Speak Like a Native: Mimicking Pronunciation and Speech Patterns
item.description: Learn how mimicking pronunciation and using techniques like shadowing can boost fluency and help you speak like a native with clarity, rhythm, and confidence.

item.title: The “Perfect Accent” Myth: How to Sound Natural and Speak With Confidence
item.description: You don’t need a perfect accent to be understood. Learn how to speak clearly, confidently, and effectively without a perfect accent.
